issue.body:
### Description

Attempting to use `custom_call` to implement primitive with ordered effects, the mlir interpreter expects the lowering rule to utilize input/output tokens (that is, the abstract eval returned an effect registered as being ordered). Previously, using the un-typed FFI (< v4) these tokens were passed through the call by prepending them to the operands and result_types. 

With the typed FFI (v4), at least on **cpu/host** platform, tokens seem to not be handled correctly.

```
2025-01-07 12:30:58.863621: F external/xla/xla/primitive_util.h:613] Unhandled primitive type 17
[1]    3638920 IOT instruction (core dumped)  python examples/experimental/mpi_reduce.py
```

The code is generated, but for example here is sample of the FFI v4 binding with the token arguments.

```c++
extern "C" _EXPORT XLA_FFI_Error*
mpi_reduce_cpu_x2DAFB30141882DDA2B7A09F7C7AE9F42_bind_execute(XLA_FFI_CallFrame* call_frame){

  static auto* binding = ffi::Ffi::Bind()
  .Attr<std::string_view>("opaque_params")
  // input tokens
  .Arg<ffi::Buffer<xla::ffi::DataType::TOKEN>>() // token
  // input arrays
  .Arg<ffi::Buffer<xla::ffi::DataType::F32>>() // in0
  // output tokens
  .Ret<ffi::Buffer<xla::ffi::DataType::TOKEN>>() // token
  // output arrays
  .Ret<ffi::Buffer<xla::ffi::DataType::F32>>() // out0
    .To(mpi_reduce_cpu_x2DAFB30141882DDA2B7A09F7C7AE9F42_execute).release();
    

  return binding->Call(call_frame);
}
```

This does seem to work without error when the platform is **CUDA/gpu**, the only difference between the two bindings is the extra argument for a cuda stream. That leads me to think its either the way tokens should be used is different than what I had assumed, or are specifically handled differently by the two platform backends. If this is more of an XLA issue I can move this there.


### System info (python version, jaxlib version, accelerator, etc.)

jax and jaxlib built from a recent development branch test_703334972 (required fix from https://github.com/openxla/xla/pull/20671)
